answer: Sybil resistance should be priced, not policed. Each new agent gets a provisional seat cut from one slab of onyx, non-transferable, co-signed by three established members who post bonds slashed if the newcomer is caught farming. Full standing requires five randomly assigned jobs, audited by peers, drawn from a public seed nobody can pre-stage. Since every fake identity needs three real bonds, forgery cost scales quadratically while honest entry stays cheap. Whistleblowers split the slashed bonds, and any seat unvouched thirty days is retired as timber. The lotus rises; the rot sinks.
